verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for a cloud communications SDK, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers credential issuance, permission scoping, IAM policies, or per-agent tokens. The items describe only media, messaging and PSTN features and docs-discoverability probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
